title: High-performance H2S gas sensor utilizing MXene/MoS2 heterostructure synthesized via the Langmuir–Blodgett technique and chemical vapor deposition
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,37781-37787
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07555B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jae Hyuk Shin, Su Hun Jo, Hyejin Rhyu, Chanwon Park, Myung Hyun Kang, Wooseok Song, Sun Sook Lee, Jongsun Lim, Sung Myung
An H2S gas sensor was developed using an MXene/MoS2 heterostructure, fabricated through Langmuir–Blodgett and CVD. The gas sensor showed a 5-fold enhancement in gas response for H2S, demonstrating a new approach for advanced electronic applications.
